purpose: Establish how the live XRP verifier compares a payment against the requested amount, and confirm it refuses a non-payment request when a matching payment exists.

tagControl.note: Same window and threshold with a tag no payment carries.

conclusions: The verifier refuses a non-payment request when a qualifying payment exists in the window. The mirror case holds.
The destination tag is genuinely part of the match criteria: changing it alone flips the same window to VALID.

The match is receivedAmount >= amount, not receivedAmount > amount as IXRPPaymentNonexistence documents. The boundary sits between 2000000 and 2000001 for a payment that received exactly 2000000, and spentAmount 2000012 is not the compared value.

LatePayShield pins the request to expectedDrops - 1. Against >= semantics that is safe, because a payment of exactly expectedDrops still blocks an overdue verdict, but it is one drop wider than intended: a payment of exactly expectedDrops - 1 also blocks it, leaving that agreement recordable as neither paid nor overdue.
